name: Tipster's Choice
description: Draw 2 cards, keep 1, return the other to the bottom.

name: Liquidation
description: Sell any number of stocks of a single color; gain +$1 per stock sold.

name: Corner the Market
description: Take one face-up market stock for free (no price move, no ability).

name: Pump and Dump
description: Sell 1 stock at double its price.

name: The Squeeze
description: Raise one stock +2, or lower one stock -2.

name: Wild Speculation
description: Reveal the top deck card to the bottom. If colored, raise or lower that color by 3; if not, reveal again.

name: Preferred Bidder
description: For the rest of the game, you win any bid you tie.

name: Hostile Takeover
description: Look at another player's hand and take 1 stock. They draw the top deck card.

name: Rumor Mill
description: Adjust every stock +1 or -1 (your choice per stock).

name: Insider Source
description: Draw the top Insider Tip into your hand; play it as a free action anytime.

name: Insider Source
description: Draw the top Insider Tip into your hand; play it as a free action anytime.

name: Oil Broker
description: Persistent: once played, pay $2 less whenever you win an auction for an Oil (Orange) stock (minimum payment $0).

name: Rail Broker
description: Persistent: once played, pay $2 less whenever you win an auction for a Rail (Green) stock (minimum payment $0).

name: Steel Broker
description: Persistent: once played, pay $2 less whenever you win an auction for a Steel (Blue) stock (minimum payment $0).

name: Bank Broker
description: Persistent: once played, pay $2 less whenever you win an auction for a Bank (Purple) stock (minimum payment $0).
